definition: Learning virtual key/value prefixes injected into every attention layer, a more expressive cousin of prompt tuning.
details: Learning virtual key/value prefixes injected into every attention layer, a more expressive cousin of prompt tuning.

explainer.lead: Prefix tuning learns virtual key/value prefixes injected into every attention layer. It matters because it adapts a frozen model more expressively than prompt tuning while leaving model weights untouched.

tiers.eli5: Instead of rewriting the book, you stick a set of learned sticky notes at the start of every page to steer how it gets read.
tiers.practitioner: Engineers train only the prefix parameters while keeping the base model frozen, so one model can host many tasks cheaply. A pitfall is that the learned prefix consumes context space and must be managed per task.
tiers.paperLevel: Prefix tuning learns virtual key/value prefixes injected into every attention layer, described as a more expressive cousin of prompt tuning.

explainer.example: To specialize a frozen model for legal text, you train a short learned key/value prefix and prepend it at each attention layer at inference.
